method: Byte-for-byte copies from exact go.mod versions in the local Go module cache and exact package-lock versions in web/node_modules; no downloads or package execution.
scope_note: All go.mod requirements and the full non-dev npm lock graph are included conservatively; this is not a symbol-level or tree-shaken bundle inventory. Development packages are supplementary. Nested node_modules and testdata are not scanned as part of their parent packages. Embedded per-source notices may need separate review.
